fields.statement: Bug 01M7M51 (conductor questions stall): the engine sends a question to the arbiter only when State.Autonomous is set, and that is set only by `run start --autonomous`. Conductor runs 01M7DVV7 and 01M7E56M (ship-rhiza, every rhiza.autonomy stage `auto`) started without the flag, so the conductor's AskUserQuestion launched an advisor and the run waited for the owner. The same happens for a hand-queued `rhiza run start <cs>`, and when daemonStart drops --autonomous because the sign-off stage is `owner`. Yet `rhiza guide conduct` says the conductor's questions always go to the arbiter. Which fix should the plan build?
